seguridad.name: rls_enabled_no_policy
seguridad.title: RLS Enabled No Policy
seguridad.description: Detects cases where row level security (RLS) has been enabled on a table but no RLS policies have been created.

findings.detail: Table \`public.admin_pospuestos\` has RLS enabled, but no policies exist
Table \`public.invitaciones\` has RLS enabled, but no policies exist
Table \`public.sesiones_ver_como\` has RLS enabled, but no policies exist

seguridad.name: anon_security_definer_function_executable
seguridad.title: Public Can Execute SECURITY DEFINER Function
seguridad.description: Detects `SECURITY DEFINER` functions that are callable without signing in. Revoke `EXECUTE`, switch the function to `SECURITY INVOKER`, or move it out of your exposed API schema if it is not meant to be public.
